$comment: Riftlight authored opening draft. Development preview only; see ../README.md. Production campaign id will be riftlight. No bonus XP: preserve the design bible campaign budget.
title: The River Chooses a Road

plate.narration: The Great River sweeps past the Frostfang ice. A rope pulls tight across the current. Just ahead, a dark ledge juts over the water. One good hold could bring everyone ashore.

goal.text: Hold on to each other and find a way out of the river.

steps.label: Find a way out of the river

current.narration: The shelf is gone, and the Great River has you. It sweeps you along the east bank, below Frostfang. The cold squeezes like a big wet hug. The rope is still in your hands, with everyone on it. Your new job: hold on to each other, and find a way out of the river.

stock.narration: Everything happens at once. The river tugs you this way and that, like a dog with a favorite sock. You need to find each other, breathe and keep your things. What comes first?

count.narration: Squeeze the rope twice, and the next hand squeezes back. Squeeze, squeeze. Every hand answers. The rope feels like one long, wet handshake.

pack_grab.narration: The packs bob along like fat, soggy ducks.
pack_grab.prompt: Hook the straps with the rope end and haul them in.

onSuccess.narration: Hook, haul, hook. In one pack, a mosslight jar still glows, soft and a bit offended.

onFailure.narration: One pack spins away, then snags on the rope. You reel it in, soggy.

rally_breath.narration: Rally lifts friends up, and everyone needs lifting. In, two, three, out. Panting turns into breathing, and breathing turns almost calm.

ride.narration: Orin's words float back: let the river carry you to a place you can get out. The east bank slides past, gray and steep, too far to reach. How will you ride the river?

feet_first.narration: Feet first means you meet rocks with your boots, not your face.
feet_first.prompt: Float on your back, boots downstream, rope tight.

onSuccess.narration: Boots up, noses up, like a very cold parade.

onFailure.narration: A wave slaps a face. Splutter, roll, and everyone makes room.

kick_bank.narration: The bank looks so near. You kick hard.
kick_bank.prompt: Kick for the east bank, pulling the others along.

onSuccess.narration: Kick, kick, kick. You edge close enough to find a slow lane by the shore.

onFailure.narration: The river is bigger than your legs. It tosses you back to the middle.

floes.narration: Pieces of the broken shelf bob all around you, flat as tables, with corners sharp as rulers. Some are big enough to climb on. How will you deal with them?

push_floes.narration: A floe the size of a door slides toward your head.
push_floes.prompt: Kick each floe away from the line.

onSuccess.narration: Bonk. Bonk. Bonk. The floes slide away, embarrassed.

onFailure.narration: One floe gets through with a rude clunk on a shoulder.

climb_floe.narration: A wide, flat floe floats beside you, like a raft that wants to help.
climb_floe.prompt: Everyone heaves onto the floe at once.

onSuccess.narration: Heave! A heap of wet coats and elbows. The floe rocks, then holds.

onFailure.narration: The floe tips you off. You climb back on.

smash_floe.narration: A floe as big as a barn door heads for the line.

onSuccess.narration: Shove! It spins away like a dropped plate.

onFailure.narration: It scrapes past, close enough to touch. Nobody is hurt, only startled.

floe_rest.narration: The big floe holds still long enough for everyone to climb on. You lie flat, breathing. In a coat pocket, a honeycake wrapped in oilcloth has stayed dry. For one minute, the river is only a bumpy road. How will you use it?

floe_warm.narration: You huddle in a wet, shivering heap. Slowly, the heap gets less shivery. Somebody's teeth are playing a tune.

floe_look.narration: Past a bend, a dark, thumb-shaped ledge sticks into the river, with a round knob on its tip. Now you know to look for it.

snag.narration: The rope jerks short. Under the water, it has hooked on a stump of ice. The floe swings in a slow circle, and the free end trails behind. What now?

unhook.narration: The line is stuck fast on the stump.
unhook.prompt: Haul the line in and free it.

onSuccess.narration: Haul! The line pops free with a splash.

onFailure.narration: The line holds for a long, tense moment, then slips off. Your arms ache.

loop_tie.narration: A big loop is a clever tool. You can throw it, hook it or hang from it.
loop_tie.prompt: Tie a big, firm loop, then work the line free.

onSuccess.narration: A big, firm loop, like a friendly mouth. The line slides free.

onFailure.narration: Lopsided, but the line slips free.

arch.narration: The river dives under an arch of white ice, like a tunnel for giants. Drips fall from the roof, and the water sounds hollow and loud. The roof is low in the middle. How will you get under?

arch_flat.narration: The roof comes down to a hand's width above the water.
arch_flat.prompt: Noses up, elbows in. Slide under.

onSuccess.narration: Whoosh. The roof brushes your noses, and the sky is back.

onFailure.narration: An icicle bonks a head. You come out with a lump and one hat fewer.

arch_look.narration: Water always finds the tallest door.
arch_look.prompt: Read the ripples and steer where the roof is highest.

onSuccess.narration: The ripples curl left. So do you, and the roof lifts like a lid.

onFailure.narration: Your high spot is a low spot with good manners. Everyone ducks and squeezes through.

arch_light.narration: You hold the mosslight jar high, and its glow shows the roof's shape.
arch_light.prompt: Steer where the glowing roof lifts.

onSuccess.narration: The roof shows its high spot like a smile. You float through as the jar fades.

onFailure.narration: The jar swings, and the roof flickers. You duck and slide under, the jar spent.

jam.narration: Ahead, a jam of tree trunks and ice is piled across the river, a spiky wall with water pouring through the gaps. The current sweeps you straight at it. How will you get past?

jam_gap.narration: Gaps are the easy way. You decide to be as sensible as water.
jam_gap.prompt: Steer into the widest gap, rope clear of the branches.

onSuccess.narration: Swish! You thread the gap like a needle.

onFailure.narration: A twig snags your hat. The river keeps the hat as its fee.

jam_push.narration: The trunks are big, but a stiff rope can still push off a wall.
jam_push.prompt: Brace the rope and push off the jam.

onSuccess.narration: The jam creaks past. A tin box clinks loose from the branches, with three lost coins inside.

onFailure.narration: The line scrapes along the jam. You come loose with twigs for souvenirs.

chute.narration: The river squeezes between two walls of ice and runs fast. It roars like a crowd of cheerful giants. The water slaps the walls, and the walls slap back. How will you go through?

chute_ride.narration: Hold the rope high, and nobody gets pulled away.
chute_ride.prompt: Hold the rope high until the water spits you out.

onSuccess.narration: Hold, hold, pop! You shoot into calmer water, damp and delighted.

onFailure.narration: The chute rattles every tooth. You come out in a tangle, but together.

chute_steer.narration: Walls are good for pushing off.
chute_steer.prompt: Kick off the walls to keep the line straight.

onSuccess.narration: Push, push, glide. You shoot out straight, like a ball down a hallway.

onFailure.narration: You spin the line around and go through backward. It is not as bad as it sounds.

chute_brace.narration: A thornguard stands in front. Even on a river, that is the job.
chute_brace.prompt: Take the bumps, so the others glide by.

onSuccess.narration: Bump, bump. The thornguard takes the knocks, and everyone glides past.

onFailure.narration: The knocks come hard. The thornguard comes out sore, still holding the rope.

slip.narration: Out of the chute, the rope jerks. A hand has slipped. Somebody slides away down the line, eyes wide, still tied on. Everyone knows what to do.

slip_haul.narration: Every hand on the rope can pull.
slip_haul.prompt: Haul your friend back, hand over hand.

onSuccess.narration: Haul, haul, haul. Your friend bumps in with a gasp and a grin.

onFailure.narration: The wet rope burns cold gloves. Slowly, your friend gets back, shivering.

slip_swing.narration: A rope can be a hand that reaches.
slip_swing.prompt: Swing the rope end over your friend's arm.

onSuccess.narration: Whoop! It drops over their arm, and the others reel them in.

onFailure.narration: The swing falls short. Then the current brings your friend close enough to catch.

shiver.narration: Everyone is still shaking. The cold has crept into your arms and legs, and your teeth rattle. A long bend lies ahead. How will you keep going?

shiver_eat.narration: You pass the food around, one small piece each. It tastes like being looked after. Warmth spreads to your toes, and the shivering gives up and goes home.

shiver_sing.narration: It does not have to be a good song. It has to be a long one, with a chorus to yell. By the second chorus, everyone is yelling, and the cold listens from far away.

shiver_paddle.narration: Hard work makes heat. You take turns on the outside of the line. Paddle, swap, paddle, swap. By the end of the bend, everyone is puffing and warm.

goats.narration: On the bank above, snowhorn goats trot along, keeping pace with you. One bleats, loud for its size, and you think of the kid. Goats know where the ground is firm. How will you use them?

goats_watch.narration: A goat never puts a hoof down by accident.
goats_watch.prompt: Watch the hooves, and call where the bank looks firm.

onSuccess.narration: The goats keep to dark, hard ice. Far ahead, a dark ledge sticks into the river.

onFailure.narration: The goats are too quick. You see a hoof or two and a blur of fluff.

goats_follow.narration: Following goats from a river is silly. It might just work.
goats_follow.prompt: Steer along the bank beside the goats.

onSuccess.narration: You drift beside the goats until they stop at a dark ledge sticking into the river.

onFailure.narration: The current outruns the goats. One bleats good-bye.

ledge_ahead.narration: At the next bend, the east bank swells into a ledge of dark ice, like a thumb. A round knob of ice sticks up from its tip. The current carries you right at it, then right past. This may be your best chance out.

aim.narration: The ledge is coming fast. Aim well, and you drift right beside it. Aim badly, and it passes you by like a bus that does not stop. How will you steer?

aim_kick.narration: Every boot can push. You steer like a very slow, very wet boat.
aim_kick.prompt: Angle your boots together toward the ledge.

onSuccess.narration: The line curves in, close enough to touch the ledge.

onFailure.narration: You turn too early. The ledge is farther, but a strong reach can still get there.

aim_swing.narration: A rope end in the water follows the current. Let the current steer.
aim_swing.prompt: Swing the rope ahead and let the current curl you in.

onSuccess.narration: The rope curls toward the bank like a lazy finger, and the line follows.

onFailure.narration: The rope tangles in a floe. You drift a little wide.

aim_sky.narration: Skyward lifts you above the water for a heartbeat.
aim_sky.prompt: Spot the best handhold, and call the steer.

onSuccess.narration: The knob stands out like a doorknob on a white door. The line follows your voice.

onFailure.narration: Wet wings drop you back in. What you saw was mostly splashing.

ledge.narration: The ledge is almost beside you. Its top is smooth, but a lip of ice sticks out above the water, and the knob stands on its tip. Who makes a handhold while the others pull?

grab.narration: The lip is smooth, cold and very close.
grab.prompt: Catch the ledge and pull the rope toward shore.

onSuccess.narration: Your hands find the lip. The rope draws everyone into shallow water.

onFailure.narration: The lip breaks away. You float clear together.

hook.narration: A knob on a ledge is like a handle on a door.
hook.prompt: Loop the rope around the knob as the current sweeps you past.

onSuccess.narration: Twang! The rope catches, and the river swings you into the shallows.

onFailure.narration: The loop slides off. The ledge slips by, and the river takes you onward.

smash.narration: A lip of ice is just a barrier pretending to be a handle.
smash.prompt: Smash a handhold, and pull the rope to it.

onSuccess.narration: The new handhold holds. Everyone reaches the shallows.

onFailure.narration: The handhold breaks off. You float onward, together.

lift.narration: Wet wings are heavy, but they can still lift a rope.
lift.prompt: Lift the rope to the ledge, and pull it into a firm hold.

onSuccess.narration: The raised rope catches the lip. You pull into shallow water.

onFailure.narration: The lip crumbles. You float clear of the falling ice.

throw_loop.narration: You tied this loop for a day like today. It is exactly knob-sized.
throw_loop.prompt: Throw your loop over the knob and pull tight.

onSuccess.narration: The loop drops over the knob as if it lives there. Everyone swings into the shallows.

onFailure.narration: The loop bounces off. The river takes you onward, together.

ashore.narration: You scramble into the shallows under the ledge. Cold water pours out of your boots. You are on the east bank under Frostfang, with the broken shelf far above. Everyone is here, and everyone is dripping.

tend.narration: Dripping is not the same as safe. Fingers are stiff, teeth chatter, and the rope is as heavy as a wet carpet. What do you need most?

tend_warm.narration: Jogging on the spot is silly, and silly things are warm. Hop, shake, wiggle! Soon steam comes off your coats, and everyone is laughing too hard to shiver.

tend_dry.narration: A wet rope is a cranky rope. Twist, squeeze, drip. The rope is a friend again, and the packs sit in the sun like sleepy cats.

early.narration: You sit on the east bank under Frostfang and coil your rope. The river carried you below the shelf, but the cairned pass is still uphill. Wet, tired and together, you are ready to climb.

tree.narration: The ice thins as the river bends. An old tree leans from the east bank, its lowest branch dragging in the current. Beyond it, dark boundary stones stand in the grass. You have to reach the branch together.

tree_choice.narration: The branch dips within reach, then lifts. One missed grip could leave a friend behind. Keep the line between you, and pick your moment.

climb.prompt: Everyone reaches the branch on the same dip.

onSuccess.narration: You climb together, and the branch brings everyone onto the bank.

onFailure.narration: The branch springs up too soon. You let go together and stay with the line.

climb.narration: The branch swings down and up, like a slow gate.

lasso.narration: A rope is for pulling. A branch is for being pulled to.
lasso.prompt: Throw the rope loop over the branch and pull everyone in.

onSuccess.narration: The loop catches. Everyone hauls, and you climb out by the old stones.

onFailure.narration: The loop slips off the wet branch. You stay with the line.

lane.narration: The slow lane you found earlier runs right under the branch.
lane.prompt: Hold the slow lane and reach on the same dip.

onSuccess.narration: The lane carries you under the branch like a moving staircase. You climb out by the old stones.

onFailure.narration: The lane bends away too soon. You stay with the line.

guide.prompt: Make a bright guide on the branch for every hand.

onSuccess.narration: Every hand follows the glowing guide. You climb out beside the old stones.

onFailure.narration: The branch lifts too soon. You stay together and float past.

call.prompt: Roar the moment, loud over the water.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone hears it and reaches. You climb onto the east bank.

onFailure.narration: You hear the roar, but the branch springs out of reach. Nobody lets go of the line.

middle.narration: You sit among boundary stones in low hills called the Red Sky Foothills. The carvings show a mountain with a strange shape. First you check on each other. Then you can study the stones.

rift.narration: A fold opens beside the current. Through it come thin cold air and a low, distant song. Dry ground seems to hang beyond the shimmer. Downriver, water breaks over pale rocks. The light around the fold is called Riftlight.

rift_choice.narration: The opening is close enough to reach without dropping the line. Will you test it, or keep looking for a shore?

river_chime.narration: One clear note sounds, with no echo. The way is ready, but you cannot count on coming back through it. Nobody can name the land beyond. You will cross together, or not at all.

river_read.narration: Your starweaver studies the light around the fold and tells everyone what they see. To the rest of you, it is only a shimmer. Thin air and a distant song are all anyone can learn.

rift_decision.narration: The fold is within reach. Beyond it lie dry ground and that low song. Downstream, the river still has a bank. Which unknown will you take?

rift_end.narration: You angle the rope toward the fold and gather at its edge. Thin air brushes your faces. Nobody has let go. You will go through all at once, together.

rapids.narration: The river quickens around pale rocks. Downstream, a bridge spans the water, and a gravel bar runs along its east bank. A flat boat waits near the bridge. You can aim for the gravel or call for help.

swim.prompt: Angle the line toward the gravel and bring everyone with you.

onSuccess.narration: You reach shallow gravel and pull the others onto it.

onFailure.narration: The current carries you past the gravel, toward the waiting boat.

signal.prompt: Wave and shout so the boatman sees you through the spray.

onSuccess.narration: A boatman points his pole to a quiet strip of water. You follow it to the gravel.

onFailure.narration: A boatman sees you too late for the gravel and pushes out to meet you.

mend_signal.prompt: Mend warms the signaler's hands. Call to the boat, loud and clear.

onSuccess.narration: A boatman hears your call and points out quiet water by the gravel.

onFailure.narration: Spray hides your signal. A boatman pushes out to meet you instead.

late.narration: You climb onto the east bank beside a bridge called Ashspan Bridge. A boatman nods from his flat boat. "Old Ossley," he says. "Dry ground at last." He points to a dry patch where you can rest.

rescue.narration: The man on the flat boat hooks your line with his pole. He helps every friend aboard and passes around a dry blanket. "Old Ossley," he says. "I turn up when I am going your way."

rescued.narration: Ossley brings the boat to the east bank beside a bridge called Ashspan Bridge. "Dry ground at last," he says. You share a supper bundle, warmer and together. The river changed your road. It did not end it.

floe_hop.narration: Flat floes drift apart and together, toward a big, calm one. Wait until they touch, then hop.

interaction.cue: Wait for the floes to touch, then tap to hop.

onSuccess.narration: Hop, hop, hop! The rope pulls everyone after you.

onFailure.narration: Too soon! Wet boots, but the rope pulls you onto the big floe.

onAssisted.narration: Together you nudge the floes closer with your boots, and everyone steps across.

jam_hold.narration: Past the jam, one branch still holds your rope. Hold the line up while a friend lifts the branch off.

interaction.cue: Hold the rope up while your friend lifts the branch off.

onSuccess.narration: Twang! The rope is free. Just ahead, something roars.

onFailure.narration: The branch will not budge. You tie a new, shorter loop. Just ahead, something roars.

onAssisted.narration: Together you tip the branch off. Something roars ahead.

scarf_pass.narration: Your friend is back, but shaking. Pass the warm scarf from the driest pack, hand to hand.

interaction.cue: Catch the scarf, then pass it on.

onSuccess.narration: Around and around goes the scarf. A tiny smile peeks over the top.

onFailure.narration: The scarf dips in the river. It arrives wet, but the thought is warm.

onAssisted.narration: Together you wrap the scarf around your friend, one loop each.

knob_toss.narration: The knob on the ledge's tip is just out of reach. Toss a loop of rope as it comes by.

interaction.cue: Tap when the loop is over the knob.

onSuccess.narration: Flup! The loop settles over the knob, and the line goes tight.

onFailure.narration: The loop slides off. Now it is only a knob.

onAssisted.narration: Together you swing the loop out, and it settles over the knob.

haul_loop.narration: The loop you hooked over the knob is holding. Everyone takes the line and pulls together. The river swings you all toward the shallows.

drake_shallows.narration: Your boots scrape onto a gravel ford. In the shallows sit two young river drakes, gray and bumpy as wet stones. River drakes like to be paid in dropped food. These two have decided you are the toll. They puff up and splash.

drake_fight.narration: The drakes slap the water and rush at the nearest boots. Shoo them off the ford, and the way on is clear.

onVictory.narration: The drakes hiccup, offended, and slide away tails first. Where they sat lies a smooth charm of river glass. You keep it.

drake_rescued.narration: The drakes win the ford, loudly. A tail flick sweeps you back into the stream. Behind you, the drakes look very pleased. Nobody is hurt, only humbled.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, funny, curious, with real consequences. Describe actions and sensory details directly. Short dialogue. Never use "the kind of thing that", "the sort of thing that", or "it was X, the type of thing that makes you Y" comparisons. Let a character act instead of explaining how the reader should feel.
voiceGuide.vocabulary: Read aloud to an eight-year-old. Concrete words, short sentences, distinct voices.

npcVoices.Old Ossley: He/him, frogfolk ferryman, few words and long pauses. Never cruel, never charges coins. No claim that the party met him in Gemfall.
